body.name: Fixed-completion certificate interface
body.construction: Given \(J\), the released exogenous configuration record \(h\), and \(\mathcal S_J\), run breadth-first search in \(H_h-J\). If disconnected, output \(D_h(J)\), \(A_h(J)\), and \(\Psi_{h,J,t,y}\); if connected, output a simple path \(\pi\), its induced \(Y\)-rooted hedge, and the parameter table for \(\mathcal M_{1,\pi},\mathcal M_{2,\pi}\).
